description: This file defines the class `HiveMqtt3SubscriptionHandler`, which extends `AbstractMqttSubscriptionHandler` and handles MQTT version 3 subscription logic using the HiveMQ MQTT client library. It primarily provides functionality to convert source data into MQTT subscription requests.

classes.name: HiveMqtt3SubscriptionHandler
classes.description: Handles subscriptions of MQTT version 3 connections using HiveMQ client. Converts source data to MQTT subscribe messages and manages subscription requests.

methods.name: HiveMqtt3SubscriptionHandler
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the handler with a connection, MQTT client, and logger.

methods.name: toMqttSubscribe
methods.description: Converts a Source object into an Optional MQTT3Subscribe message by mapping addresses to MQTT subscriptions with QoS levels.
